name: img-tabs-standalone
blurb: Self-contained image tabs with no external context needed.
description: Standalone tab component managing its own state. Click tabs to switch content, image, and description. No props required; fully self-contained.
use_when: Embedded sections where a complete tab widget is needed without parent management.
avoid_when: Controlled tab components; this is uncontrolled.
a11y: Tab buttons are keyboard-navigable. Images have alt text. Descriptions are semantic.
